title: Libya’s central bank chief resigns
snippet: TRIPOLI: The governor of Libya’s central bank, Naji Issa, has resigned without giving a reason, several reports said on Monday. Private TV channel Al-Ahrar said Issa had confirmed his resignation. Issa and vice-governor Miree Al-Barasee were appointed by Libya’s parliament, which is based in the east of the divided country, in September 2024. His appointment was part of a deal backed by the United Nations that ended a standoff over Libya’s oil production and a deep financial crisis.
